theater: 泰國西北部帕府與那空一帶山區

battle.name: 第二次泰法戰爭
battle.theater: 泰國西北部帕府與那空一帶山區
battle.brief: 中文維基《戰爭列表》所列第二次泰法戰爭於1940年11月爆發，泰國與維希法國在泰國西北部及法屬印度支那邊境交戰，衝突集中於山地邊防與據點爭奪。此條點名的裝備為加特林機槍（Gatling gun），1860年已列裝，是早期制式連發武器，但並非本場戰爭實際使用的主力裝備。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 加特林機槍是美國陸軍早期制式連發武器，配置於步兵分隊，負責持續火力支援，是近代機槍的重要先驅，在武器體系中具有承先啟後的地位。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方是暹羅王國與法國部署在印度支那的軍事力量。五月三日開戰時，法國本土仍由第三共和國政府主持，但巴黎很快遭到德軍進逼，並於六月十六日簽訂、二十二日生效停戰協定；殖民地部隊沒有自動停止作戰，後來接受維希政權的節制，法屬印度支那遠征軍、外籍營及當地殖民部隊仍繼續抵抗暹羅。暹羅投入的是本國陸軍正規師、預備部隊、工兵、砲兵與航空隊，主要戰區集中於寮國、湄公河中游、柬埔寨北部邊境及後來的海灣 naval 一帶。交戰並不遍及整個印度支那，東京、海防與南部的防務仍由法軍控制。日本不是這場戰爭的交戰國，但自九月起居中促成停火，並於九月二十二日占領印度支那北部，因而成為區域局勢的另一支力量。
countriesEn: The belligerents were the Kingdom of Siam and French military forces deployed in Indochina. When the fighting began on 3 May, metropolitan France was still governed by the Third Republic, but Paris was rapidly pushed back by Germany and signed an armistice on 16 June, effective on 22 June. Fighting in the colonies did not stop automatically. The French Indochina expeditionary force, Foreign Legion formations, and local colonial troops continued to resist Siam and subsequently operated under the authority of Vichy. Siam committed regular army divisions, reserves, engineers, artillery, and an air service. The principal land theaters were Laos, the middle Mekong, the northern Cambodian frontier, and later the Gulf of Thailand. The war was not fought throughout Indochina, since France still controlled Hanoi, Haiphong, and the southern provinces. Japan was not a belligerent, but it mediated the armistice from September and occupied northern Indochina on 22 September, becoming another power in the regional balance.
people: 暹羅方面的最高決策者是總理兼陸軍元帥普拉埃克·披汶宋康（Plaek Phibunsongkhram），他兼任最高統帥，決定出兵目標、批准作戰計畫，並在戰局陷入僵持後接受日本調停。實際統籌三路進攻與部隊調動的是披拉耀·帕洪（Phraya Phahon Chotivat），他以總參謀長身分掌握兵力和糧秣安排。法軍最高指揮官為亨利－亞歷山大·喬治（Henri-Alexandre Georges）將軍；巴黎停戰後，他與參謀長莫里斯·比格爾（Maurice Bigeard）仍主張維持印度支那防線，使法泰衝突越過歐洲停戰而延續下去。比格爾尤其強調法軍尚能依托寮國與柬埔寨邊境抵抗，不能把放棄作戰視為必然。日本外相重光（Mamoru Shigemitsu）代表東京推動九月停火，但日本沒有指揮暹羅地面部隊，也沒有把自身變成這場戰爭的交戰者。這些人分別掌握政治決定、軍事執行、殖民地防務與外部調停，構成了戰爭的主要指揮鏈。
peopleEn: Siam's principal political decision-maker was Prime Minister and Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram, who also acted as supreme commander. He approved the objectives and operational plan, directed the initial mobilization, and later accepted Japanese mediation when the front had stabilized. Phraya Phahon Chotivat, chief of the General Staff, handled the practical direction of the three axes of attack and the movement of troops and supplies. The overall French commander was General Henri-Alexandre Georges. After the metropolitan armistice, Georges and his chief of staff, Maurice Bigeard, continued to uphold the defense of Indochina, allowing the conflict to continue beyond the European ceasefire. Bigeard in particular argued that the French position in Laos and along the Cambodian frontier remained defensible and that operations should not simply be abandoned. Japanese Foreign Minister Mamoru Shigemitsu represented Tokyo in promoting the September ceasefire, although Japan neither commanded Siamese ground forces nor became a belligerent in this war. Their respective control of political decisions, operational execution, colonial defense, and external mediation formed the main command structure of the campaign.
kits: 雙方使用的武器均屬一九四〇年以前已服役的型號。法軍步兵以Lebel 1886步槍、Berthier 1907／15步槍為主，搭配Hotchkiss 1914及1929式輕機槍、37毫米1916式自動步槍，砲兵則有75毫米1897式野砲、155毫米C型1917式榴彈砲與81毫米Brandit迫擊砲；法屬印度支那裝甲序列可見Hotchkiss H39輕戰車，但山區道路使戰車難以成為主要力量。航空方面，法軍使用過Potez 25、Blériot-SPAD S.33與Morane-Saulnier MS.406等機型，擔任戰鬥、偵察及轟炸任務。湄公河上的Hache、Massue與Doudart de Lagrée等內河砲艇可支援沿江射擊，遠洋兵力則包括1925年服役的巡洋艦Dupleix與潛艦Persée。暹羅步兵使用Type 88、Type 98步槍、Type 11輕機槍及Type 93重機槍，砲兵同樣裝有75毫米等級野砲與Vickers 75毫米山砲；義大利製M11／39輕戰車於1938年已列裝，可在部分道路較平坦的段落支援進攻。泰國航空隊有Breda Ba.27、Fokker D.XXI、Mitsubishi Ki-10與Nakajima Ki-27戰鬥機，以及Breda Ba.65偵察／輕型轟炸機。海上與邊境兵力包括1936年服役的驅逐艦HTMS Thonburi、巡洋艦HTMS Naresuan與HTMS Sri Ayudhya，以及內河砲艇HTMS Chao Phraya。這些型號的具體數量和分區會隨補強而變動，不能把清冊視為每條戰線同時在場的固定編制。
kitsEn: Both sides used types already in service before 1940. French infantry relied on the Lebel Model 1886 and Berthier Model 1907/15 rifles, supported by Hotchkiss Model 1914 and 1929 light machine guns and the 37 mm Model 1916 automatic rifle. French artillery included the 75 mm Model 1897 field gun, 155 mm C Model 1917 howitzer, and 81 mm Brandit mortar. The French Indochina armored order included the Hotchkiss H39 light tank, although mountain roads limited its role. French aircraft in service in the theater included the Potez 25, Blériot-SPAD S.33, and Morane-Saulnier MS.406 for combat, reconnaissance, and bombing. Mekong river gunboats such as Hache, Massue, and Doudart de Lagrée supported riverbank operations, while the longer-range naval force included the 1925-vintage sloop Dupleix and submarine Persée. Siamese infantry used Type 88 and Type 98 rifles, Type 11 light machine guns, and Type 93 heavy machine guns. Siamese artillery likewise included 75 mm field and mountain guns, including the Vickers 75 mm mountain gun, while Italian M11/39 light tanks, in service since 1938, supported attacks on the more practicable roads. The Royal Thai Air Force operated Breda Ba.27, Fokker D.XXI, Mitsubishi Ki-10, and Nakajima Ki-27 fighters, together with Breda Ba.65 reconnaissance and light-bomber aircraft. Naval and frontier forces included the 1936-vintage destroyer HTMS Thonburi, sloops HTMS Naresuan and HTMS Sri Ayudhya, and river gunboat HTMS Chao Phraya. Numbers and allocations changed with reinforcements, so this inventory should not be treated as a fixed order of battle present simultaneously on every front.
tactics: 五月三日午後，暹羅沒有把兵力集中在單一突破點，而是以北方、中部與東部三路展開攻勢。北方部隊由清邁一帶經清堪向琅勃拉邦推進，利用工兵先行處理渡河、狹窄道路和前線障礙；中央主力從呵叻出發，沿山間道路向萬象、沙灣拿吉方向壓進；東部部隊則由阿蘭布拉特越入柬埔寨，向Stung Treng及法軍 southern Laos 退路橫向伸展。這種多方向進攻使法軍沿邊境的孤立哨所難以相互支援，也讓泰軍逐步取得琅勃拉邦、萬象與若干機場。法軍初期依靠機槍射界、75毫米砲火、迫擊砲、路障和河岸砲艇建立縱深防守，再以快速部隊實施側擊；泰軍則把步兵攻勢、砲火準備、架橋勤務與航空兵力集中在同一時段。五月二十三日，法軍航空兵奇襲清邁後方機場，摧毀部分地面航空設備；泰國航空隊則打擊琅勃拉邦、萬象、巴色與川擴一帶的法軍場站，迫使法機必須從越南北部或柬埔寨方向轉場，飛行距離與續航壓力都較大。六月初法軍在沙灣拿吉至巴色一線反攻，曾迫使巴色周邊據點一度易手，但補給線拉長後只能退回較短的縱深；泰軍封閉山地道路，以砲兵和空襲削弱反攻力量。雙方後勤同樣受地形約束：泰軍可利用曼谷至清邁、曼谷至呵叻的鐵路作遠端集結，再用卡車、獸力運輸和徒步行進；法軍則由海防、河內或西貢方向經空運及湄公河船運補給。75毫米炮彈、炸藥、機槍彈與航空燃料都需要越過漫長運輸線。九月停火後，地面部隊沒有立即解除戒備，工事、巡邏和零星交火延續到十一月三十日。
tacticsEn: On the afternoon of 3 May, Siam dispersed its strength across northern, central, and eastern axes rather than concentrating on a single breach. The northern force advanced from the Chiang Mai area through Chiang Kham toward Luang Prabang, with engineers clearing river crossings, narrow roads, and immediate obstacles. The central column departed from Korat and pressed through the mountain roads toward Vientiane and Savannakhet. In the east, troops crossed from Aranyaprathet into Cambodia and extended toward Stung Treng and the French withdrawal route from southern Laos. This multidirectional attack made it difficult for isolated French border posts to support one another and allowed Siam to occupy Luang Prabang, Vientiane, and several airfields in stages. Initially, the French relied on interlocking machine-gun fields, 75 mm guns, mortars, roadblocks, and river gunboats to construct depth, then used mobile columns for flank attacks. Siam concentrated infantry movement, artillery preparation, bridging work, and air support within the same operational windows. On 23 May, French aircraft raided the Chiang Mai airfield and destroyed ground equipment; the Royal Thai Air Force struck French positions and airfields around Luang Prabang, Vientiane, Pakse, and Xieng Khouang, forcing French aircraft to fly longer routes from northern Vietnam or Cambodia and imposing severe endurance and turnaround requirements. In early June, a French counteroffensive between Savannakhet and Pakse briefly changed hands around several positions, but the extended supply line compelled the French to fall back to a shorter defensive depth. Siam closed mountain routes and used artillery and bombing to weaken the counterattack. Terrain constrained both sides' logistics. Siam could concentrate forces by rail at Bangkok, Chiang Mai, and Korat and then move by truck, animal transport, and foot. France supplied from Haiphong, Hanoi, or Saigon by air and Mekong steamer. 75 mm ammunition, explosives, machine-gun ammunition, and aviation fuel all had to cross long transport routes. After the September ceasefire, troops did not immediately stand down, and fortifications, patrols, and isolated clashes continued until 30 November.
data: 一九四〇年五月三日，暹羅部隊在寮國方向同時發動進攻。頭幾日內，法軍在琅勃拉邦與萬象周邊的前哨失去聯絡，兩地先後易手；泰軍飛機攻擊法軍在琅勃拉邦、萬象和巴色的駐地，法軍則從湄公河砲艇和航空兵兩個方向反擊。五月十九日前後，中部戰線集中到沙灣拿吉與巴色之間，法軍利用反擊奪回部分前進陣地；到六月初，巴色周邊控制權再次轉換，但法軍無法把戰果延伸成穩定突破。五月二十三日，法軍轟炸機奇襲清邁機場，泰方航空設備受到損失；泰國空軍則持續壓制川擴與沿江法軍陣地，使法軍反攻必須先處理基地受襲及補給線中斷。六月十六日法國在巴黎簽訂停戰協定，六月二十二日生效，但印度支那戰事沒有同步終止。喬治與比格爾維持指揮，持續抵抗，使戰爭進入政治上隸屬維希、軍事上仍在交戰的第二階段。六月下旬至八月，壓力集中在南寮、Stung Treng與柬埔寨邊境；法軍依托據點、砲兵和內河艇守住交通線，泰軍則逐步封閉各支路。九月，日本介入調停，同月二十二日占領印度支那北部；泰法接受初步停火安排後，少數邊境地區仍有巡邏與交火，直到十一月三十日才大致停止。停火後、正式和約前，泰國海軍驅逐艦HTMS Thonburi於十二月九日在泰國灣攻擊法軍巡洋艦Dupleix與潛艦Persée，兩艇均告沉沒，事件迫使交涉回到停火及軍艦活動條款。這次海上事件沒有重新開啟寮國地面戰線，但增加了正式條約的急迫性；十二月十日簽訂的法泰和約隨後處理了軍隊撤回、割地與邊界承認問題。
dataEn: On 3 May 1940, Siamese forces launched simultaneous attacks into Laos. Within the first days, French outposts around Luang Prabang and Vientiane lost contact and both places changed hands. Thai aircraft attacked French positions at Luang Prabang, Vientiane, and Pakse, while the French replied through Mekong gunboats and aircraft. Around 19 May, the central front concentrated between Savannakhet and Pakse, and a French counterattack recovered some forward positions. By early June, control around Pakse changed hands again, but the French could not convert the recovery into a sustained breakthrough. On 23 May, French bombers raided the Chiang Mai airfield and damaged Thai ground aviation equipment; the Thai air arm continued to pressure French positions around Xieng Khouang and the river route, forcing the French to cope with attacked bases and interrupted supply lines before any counteroffensive could develop. France signed the metropolitan armistice in Paris on 16 June, effective on 22 June, but the war in Indochina did not end with it. Georges and Bigeard retained command and continued resistance, creating a second phase in which the military conflict continued under Vichy political authority. From late June through August, pressure centered on southern Laos, Stung Treng, and the Cambodian frontier. The French held communications with fortified posts, artillery, and river craft, while Siam gradually closed the roads leading into the area. Japan entered the mediation in September and occupied northern Indochina on 22 September. After the Thai and French sides accepted preliminary ceasefire arrangements, patrols and limited clashes continued in a few frontier sectors until the fighting largely ended on 30 November. After the ceasefire but before the formal peace treaty, the Siamese destroyer HTMS Thonburi attacked the French sloop Dupleix and submarine Persée in the Gulf of Thailand on 9 December. Both vessels sank. The incident did not reopen the land war in Laos, but it forced the negotiations back to ceasefire and naval-access provisions, adding urgency to the settlement. A Franco-Siamese peace treaty signed on 10 December subsequently addressed troop withdrawals, territorial transfers, and recognition of the frontier.
cause: 戰爭的直接原因是法泰邊界談判破裂，而不是單一突發事件。1893年法暹條約及其後1904、1925年的邊界安排，在琅勃拉邦、琅勃拉邦以北的湄公河小支流，以及Stung Treng、達叻等一帶留下相互重疊的主權主張。1938至1939年間，暹羅曾進入數個爭議區，巴黎要求撤回，法方則拒絕承認由軍事占領造成的現狀。1940年初，暹羅要求法國歸還1938年後占領的土地，並調整寮國方向的宗主權與邊界安排；法國擔心承認這些要求會破壞其對寮國的保護權，也會使法軍在湄公河沿線的防衛失去縱深，因此未予接受。五月德軍進攻西歐後，法國政府無法有效向印度支那派遣增援，巴黎陷落又使海運與遠程指揮中斷，曼谷因而判斷法屬印度支那短期內難以取得大批法軍或空中支援，遂下令全面出兵。這不等於日本直接迫使暹羅開戰，因為五月三日的大規模進攻發生在日本占領印度支那北部之前；日本較早的南進意向和亞洲局勢變化只是改變了曼谷對法國抵抗能力的估計。六月歐洲停戰後，維希政府要求殖民地當局尋求和解，但喬治與比格爾仍維持抵抗，於是原本可由外交迅速收束的邊界衝突延長成持續七個月的陸戰。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the breakdown of Franco-Siamese negotiations rather than a single isolated incident. The 1893 Franco-Siamese treaty and later border arrangements of 1904 and 1925 left overlapping sovereignty claims around Luang Prabang, the Mekong tributaries north of that city, and areas including Stung Treng and Trat. During 1938 and 1939, Siam had entered several disputed zones and was required by Paris to withdraw; the French refused to treat positions created by military occupation as a valid settlement. In early 1940, Siam demanded the return of land occupied since 1938 and a revision of French suzerainty and the frontier in Laos. France feared that acceptance would undermine its protectorate over Laos and remove the depth of the Mekong defense line, and rejected the demands. After Germany attacked western Europe in May, the French government could no longer send substantial reinforcements or maintain effective long-distance command to Indochina. The impending fall of Paris further disrupted maritime supply and communications, leading Bangkok to judge that French Indochina would be unable to receive large military or air reinforcements in the near term. This was not simply an order imposed by Japan: the major invasion began before Japan occupied northern Indochina. Earlier Japanese expansion and the changing Asian balance affected Bangkok's estimate of French resistance, but did not itself constitute the order to invade. After the European armistice, the Vichy government instructed the colonial authorities to seek a settlement. Georges and Bigeard nevertheless maintained resistance, extending what might have been settled quickly by diplomacy into seven months of land warfare.
impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了法軍在印度支那的防務負擔。暹羅雖然取得寮國境內的實際控制優勢，卻沒有迫使法國放棄海防、河內、西貢或柬埔寨；法軍仍能以南部和越南北部為基地，在一九四一年阻止日本取得全印度支那的空中基地。日本藉九月調停及占領北部，擴大了在印度支那的既得位置；維希法軍則因戰力與補給受限，更難同時應付北方日本軍與南方英美方面的壓力。對法國而言，琅勃拉邦及占巴塞方向的宗主權喪失、寮國內部親暹勢力上升，加上法泰海戰中損失Dupleix與Persée，使海軍在印度支那的指揮與掩護能力受到實際質疑。對暹羅而言，邊境取得較佳縱深，軍事聲望與國內政府的執政地位都獲得支撐；但東京的調停也顯示，暹羅並不能完全不受區域大國約束。珍珠港事件發生後，暹羅選擇與日本簽訂同盟並進入戰局，這是後續政策，不能簡化為1940年戰爭的直接產物。戰爭留下的真正變化，是法國在寮國的間接控制被削弱、日本在北部建立直接占領區，以及泰法之間形成一套需要重新標界的軍事邊界。
impactEn: The war first changed the defensive burden carried by France in Indochina. Although Siam gained a substantial position inside Laos, it did not force France to relinquish Haiphong, Hanoi, Saigon, or Cambodia. The French could still use southern Vietnam and northern Vietnam as bases and prevent Japan from obtaining air bases throughout Indochina in 1941. Japanese mediation in September, followed by the occupation of the north, expanded Tokyo's established position. The Vichy French, meanwhile, had fewer troops and shorter effective supply lines while facing Japanese pressure in the north and British, American, and other concerns in the south. For France, the loss of suzerainty over Luang Prabang and Champasak, the growth of pro-Siamese influence within Laos, and the sinking of Dupleix and Persée exposed real weaknesses in French command, naval escort, and control of the frontier. Siam obtained greater strategic depth, and the military result reinforced the standing of the Bangkok government. The Japanese mediation also showed that Siam could not act entirely independently of the region's major powers. After Pearl Harbor, Siam signed an alliance with Japan and entered the wider war; this was a subsequent decision rather than a direct mechanical consequence of the 1940 campaign. The durable changes were the weakening of indirect French control in Laos, the establishment of a direct Japanese occupation zone in the north, and a Thai-French frontier requiring a new demarcation process.
result: 十二月十日簽訂的法泰和約確認了暹羅在地面作戰中的優勢，卻不是法國被逐出印度支那的全面投降。法國正式放棄對琅勃拉邦與占巴塞一帶的宗主權，承認暹羅在這些地區取得的控制；泰國則撤出不被最終條約承認的柬埔寨占區，將Stung Treng交還柬埔寨，並把達叻歸還法國。其餘寮國仍維持法國保護權安排，柬埔寨、海防、河內及南部各省也繼續由法方控制，兩軍按協議撤回各自承認的界線，後續由聯合委員會逐步標界。因此，最精確的結論是：暹羅獲得可量化的領土與邊界利益，法軍則保住印度支那的主要殖民行政中心，但失去在寮國部分地區的宗主權與緩衝地帶。關於雙方總傷亡，戰後公報與後來研究對陣亡、重傷、失蹤、病患、空軍損失及軍艦失事採用的統計口徑並不一致；本文不列出一個無法交叉核實的精確總數，也不把各次戰鬥中的零散估算相加冒充確定數字。已能確認的結果包括泰軍取得上述寮國地區、法軍繼續控制其餘印度支那，以及兩艘法軍艦艇在十二月九日事件中沉沒。
resultEn: The Franco-Siamese treaty signed on 10 December confirmed Siam's advantage in the land campaign without amounting to the complete expulsion of France from Indochina. France formally relinquished suzerainty over the Luang Prabang and Champasak areas and recognized Siam's control there. Siam withdrew from Cambodian territory not recognized in the final settlement, returned Stung Treng to Cambodia, and restored Trat to France. French protectorate arrangements continued over the rest of Laos, while Cambodia, Haiphong, Hanoi, and the southern provinces remained under French control. Both armies withdrew to the lines recognized in the agreement, after which a joint commission began the gradual demarcation of the frontier. The precise result was therefore a territorial and positional gain for Siam, coupled with the loss of French suzerainty and buffer influence in parts of Laos, while France preserved the principal administrative centers of Indochina. Postwar bulletins and later studies used inconsistent definitions for dead, wounded, missing, sick, air losses, and naval casualties. For that reason, this account does not present a single total that cannot be independently verified, and it does not add isolated estimates from separate engagements and label the result definitive. The confirmable outcomes were Siamese control of the stated Lao territories, continued French control of the rest of Indochina, and the sinking of two French vessels in the incident of 9 December.
